decisions.reason: Correctly ties top-level ESM import to the classic-script boot combo: one parse error kills the whole unit, 0/53 register, named stock entry is the first awaited victim, and it explicitly notes ESM is only invalid in this classic-script context.

Bisects the insert rows, uses vm.Script classic-script parsing as the primary gate (with the package.json type-module caveat on node --check), and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) bundle: id = package name, host React via require in the factory, inject/apply exports, return module.exports.

Correctly explains another entry owns the declaration and that apply ordering can race, and bans kind/scope on registrants; but it never gives the required deferred form (ctx.slots.inject(name, () => register(...)) or equivalent) — instead it proposes an invented parent/children-table register API while also forbidding children on registrants.

Explains the combo is composed once at boot so edits/refresh cannot rebuild it, prescribes full stop/restart per iteration with port verification, taskkill /PID /T /F for the orphaned tree, and explains EADDRINUSE as the old process holding the port, not a packaging defect.

Strong host-side per-entry validation, culprit attribution, and a detailed template/checklist covering loader factory, host React, inject/apply, and restart/Windows tree cleanup; but the checklist's slot guidance lacks the required deferred cross-entry registration (only 'register inside apply'), so one of the mandated prevention areas is incomplete.

caps.reason: Final advice mandates the classic wrapper, forbids kind/scope on registrants, and requires full host restarts; HMR is mentioned only as an optional host-side enhancement, not as a substitute for restarts.
